decision_rule: Do not claim efficacy from the one-document feasibility run. Require a preregistered, power-justified paired or stepped rollout against a documented baseline, report uncertainty, and stratify by baseline writer skill and task class.
efficacy_design: paired or stepped rollout over live documents, selected before outcomes are inspected
estimand: change in human-feedback rounds to reader acceptance, subject to no increase in meaning-preservation violations or reader time
feasibility_scope: one live document for integration, telemetry, privacy, stop-rule, and burden testing only
holdout_rule: Freeze tuning and held-out splits before reporting package or workflow effectiveness.
kill_criteria: reader acceptance does not improve or becomes slower after two pilot cycles
meaning-preservation violations exceed the pre-specified tolerance
diagnostic false positives consume more review time than they save
privacy or disclosure requirements cannot be met
planning_scope: Twelve weeks covers implementation and one feasibility document; efficacy timing follows the power or precision analysis and live-document arrival rate.
sample_size_rule: simulate power or precision from the observed baseline distribution of feedback rounds and reader clustering; do not choose an arbitrary document count
